observations: Three photos show a set of three dark brown sofas with gold-colored trim on the armrests and legs.
The sofas have a tufted backrest with diamond stitching and a quilted pattern on the back panel.
Photo 0 shows two sofas side by side, with a third sofa partially visible on the right.
Photo 1 shows the full set arranged in a row, with one sofa on the left, one in the middle, and one on the right.
Photo 2 shows a close-up of the rightmost sofa, with a single cushion on it.
All sofas appear to be made of fabric with a velvet-like texture.
The armrests have gold-colored trim that appears to be metal or plastic.
The legs are short, round, and appear to be made of wood or metal.
The floor is tiled and reflective, and the room has white walls with framed artwork.
No visible stains, tears, or major damage in the photos.
The seller claims '2 seater and 1 sofa' — this may be a misstatement, as photo 0 shows two sofas and one sofa is partially visible, but the third sofa is not fully shown.

claims.claim: Used 2 seater and 1 sofa in great condition
claims.evidence: Photos show the sofas in good condition with no visible damage, but there is no proof of usage history or wear. The term '2 seater' is ambiguous — the photos show three pieces, but only two are fully visible in photo 0. The third piece is partially visible, but not clearly identifiable as a 2-seater.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear not visible in photos, such as stains, tears, or structural issues in the fabric or frame.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the fabric, seams, and underside of each sofa, including the back and legs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential hidden damage, which may reduce value.

risks.risk: The third piece is not a 2-seater as claimed, or is not part of the set.
risks.proof: A clear shot of the third piece showing its seat count and design.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a 2-seater and 1 sofa set, but with uncertainty about the third piece's inclusion.

risks.proof: Video or photo showing the cushions being pressed and released, and the underside of the sofas.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially low-quality or damaged, which may reduce value.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the fabric, seams, and underside of each sofa, including the back and legs.
A clear shot of the third piece to confirm it is a 2-seater or not included.
A video or photo showing the cushions being pressed and released, and the underside of the sofas.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
